mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(A.EPISODE, '%m월 %d일') AS episode, B.USER_ID AS userId FROM MEETING_SCHEDULE A LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT * FROM PARTICIPANT_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}) B ON A.EPISODE = B.EPISODE WHERE A.COMPLETE_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY A.EPISODE ASC

SELECT episode from MEETING_SCHEDULE WHERE EPISODE = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AND HEADCOUNT >= ( select COUNT(*) from participant_user a where a.episode = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') )
